card.name: The word opioid before overdose reversal agent
card.fires_on: The word "opioid" right after "an" in the phrase "consider recommending or prescribing an opioid overdose reversal agent". It appears in opioid label warnings about addiction, misuse and respiratory depression.

modes.description: The word opioid follows "recommending or prescribing an" and comes just before "overdose reversal agent".
